expect_red: the placement rule: every recorded occurrence is drawn, a pathological count is capped and says so, and a part with none says it is at its own origin

mutations.contract: An opened part is drawn at EVERY occurrence the assembly records (up to a cap no real part reaches), and a part past the cap or with no position says so -- never silently drawn once.
mutations.note: The mutation draws only the first occurrence, which is the 'silently drawing one' the handoff warned against: the tangential link would sit at one of its three slots and nothing would say the other two are missing.
